summary: Frontend-only full regression completed on public preview URL for all requested P0 cinematic investor/customer flows, six destination films, reduced-motion behavior, responsive breakpoints, and global route isolation. No blocking defects found in this run.
action_items: No mandatory fixes from this pass.
Optional: keep Playwright waits >=1.5s when validating manual scene control mapping because smooth scrolling is intentional and can cause false negatives with short waits.
critical_code_review_comments: Gateway implementation correctly enforces system-formation-first behavior and only then reveals investor/customer choices; reduced-motion path correctly bypasses formation.
Customer selector uses compact progressive disclosure (role -> department -> industry -> summary) with query-param persistence and back navigation; no taxonomy-wall regression observed.

All six destination routes are isolated cinematic film implementations with 5 scene controls, persistent animated stage, human authority indicator, and proof boundaries (BUILT/ARCHITECTURE + MODELED on customer routes).
No hardcoded backend URL usage detected in tested investor surfaces; waitlist submit path uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL as required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed broad Playwright regression on public URL: verified timed gateway formation, skip behavior, investor branch/back-reset, customer progressive flow + filters + URL persistence + destination launch, all six destination films, booking/waitlist actions on each route, reduced-motion usability, no horizontal overflow at 1920x800 / 768x1024 / 390x844, global / and /demo unaffected, and scoped data-testid coverage/uniqueness for gateway, customer selector, and destinations.
rca of the issue: No new defects reproduced in this cycle. One transient false-negative pattern was observed only in test automation when scene-click wait time was too short; root cause is expected smooth-scroll transition timing, not product logic failure.
